entity.name: Hubert Szymański
entity.description: Sole maintainer of Redtail, an open-source verification layer for physical-asset provenance. I maintain the public verification-relevant core, including Base L2 anchoring documentation, canonical hashing utilities, verifier modules, public test vectors, and standards-focused documentation.

projects.name: Redtail
projects.description: Redtail is an open-source verification layer for physical-asset provenance. The public repository contains the verification-relevant core: documented Base L2 anchoring format, canonical hashing utilities, a headless verifier, public test vectors, and standards-focused documentation. Funding would support open-source verifier hardening, protocol documentation, additional test vectors, and independent verifier implementations.

channels.description: Please contact the maintainer by email to coordinate funding logistics.

plans.name: Open-source verification tooling support
plans.description: One-time funding to support Redtail's open-source verification tooling: hardening the public verifier path, expanding valid and invalid test vectors, improving protocol documentation, preparing independent verifier implementations, and making Base L2 integrity-anchor verification easier for third-party developers to inspect and reproduce.
